evidence.R1-01: Packet Round 3 Q4 'If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order ... Re-read fails, say outcome unknown' vs round0 row 101 'Make no further CO-A2 and no CO-A3; tell the customer it is not known' with no lookup; row 104 reports 'refund has not been issued' after an unanswered first CO-A3 that Appendix A says may have created the refund.
evidence.R1-02: Appendix A CO-A3 'the order is not cancelled: OrderNotCancelled' is injected in CO-S17 row 3 right after CO-A2 returned cancelled, while Final state says 'HG-10482 has status cancelled' and row 103 has the agent say 'the order is cancelled'.
evidence.R1-03: Packet Round 3 Q3 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet' vs round0 row 105, CO-S20 step 10 and rubric 'Refund not issued reported' requiring 'the refund has not been issued'.
evidence.R1-04: Packet Round 3 Q1 'The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives' appears only as must-not bullet line 49; no CO rule, and no dimension in lines 1495-1509 checks it.
evidence.R1-05: Round0 row 96 trigger 'in the confirming turn or after confirming' has no scenario; CO-S03 Turn 2 is 'in place of a confirmation' (line 248) and its note says it 'confirms nothing'.
evidence.R1-06: G-01 'the one order the current request is about' and CO-06 per-conversation limits forbid a second order only by implication; no rule says what to tell the customer and no scenario asks for two orders, though CO-S02/CO-S03 start with two open orders.
evidence.R1-07: Packet confirmed derivation 'An already cancelled order: the agent reports that and changes nothing' is implemented word for word by round0 row 93 and asserted by CO-S06 'Already cancelled reported'.
evidence.R1-08: G-04 permits a repeat 'when the order system guarantees that repeating it creates nothing new', and SG-04 is such a guarantee for cancel, so G-04 literally allows the blind cancel resend packet Round 3 Q4 forbids ('no blind resend'); CO-06 pins behavior, so no verdict changes.
evidence.R1-09: Packet Round 2 Q3 Refund fields are 'refund id, order number, amount, payment method, status (pending, issued, failed)'; round0 Appendix A line 1525 adds 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, payment_method_expired or declined)'.
evidence.R1-10: Round0 failure rows 89-97 cover only a named order or several open orders; nothing covers 'cancel my order' with no open order, and no scenario tests it.
evidence.R2-01: Quoted round-1 row 'no CO-A3 or CO-A4 until a lookup made after it answers' contradicts its own last branch 'If the lookup does not answer ... make CO-A4'; final spec row 105 shows the fix splitting the gate.
evidence.R2-02: The case is defined and asserted: the row says 'If it shows the order placed or processing, tell the customer the order was not cancelled and no refund was issued, and make no CO-A3 or CO-A4', CO-S27 asserts it via 'Cancellation not made reported' (final line 1721); no input or §2 interest requires a further next step.
evidence.R2-L2: §5.1 'Final state assertions ... are read against Initial state' and evaluation-checklist 'Isolated trials. Each trial starts from the Initial state with no leftovers' mean an unlisted task does not exist; global vs per-order reading gives the same verdict.
evidence.R2-L3: evaluation-checklist line 39: 'A User turn's trigger names an event §5.1 defines ... never "a proposal"'; round0 CO-S03 line 248 and CO-S04 line 308 anchor Turn 2 on 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482 and asks to go ahead'.
evidence.R2-03: Packet Round 2 Q1 names only the race 'status can flip processing → shipped between the agent's read and its cancel call'; CO-S26 row 2 jumps processing to delivered at the second CO-A2.
evidence.R2-04: After R1-09 removed failure_reason, round0 trajectories CO-S17 step 6 (line 1045), CO-S22 step 6 (line 1336), CO-S23 step 6 (line 1394) still show 'refund RF-5531, failed, card closed'.
evidence.R2-05: Quoted row tells the customer 'store staff will follow up' before 'make CO-A4', while CO-07 says the agent tells this 'once the order system has created the task' and the CO-A3 rows list CO-A4 first.
evidence.R2-06: Round-1 row 'Tell the customer, for each of their orders, what CO-01 says for its status' is triggered only by CO-S05 row 4 with one delivered order, so the per-order and cancelled branches are never asserted.
evidence.R2-07: The condition 'none of their orders has status placed or processing' matches a customer with no orders, for whom 'for each of their orders' produces no message; no rule or scenario covers it.
evidence.R3-01: Round-2 no-order row omits 'has shipped' that CO-01 and 'Shipped order explained' (CO-S05 row 4) require; second-CO-A2 lookup-fails branch omits 'that no refund was issued' that 'Cancellation outcome unknown reported' (CO-S15) requires; final spec rows 97 and 105 add both.
evidence.R3-02: Round-2 no-order row has a conditional returns clause but only CO-S05 row 4 (single delivered order) triggers it; no scenario has a customer with no orders, all-cancelled orders or several non-open orders.
